name: patent-filing-qc
title_zh: 70 多项检查逐条过，交 USPTO 前先替你当一回
tagline_zh: 说明书、附图、ADS、声明、转让书、代理委托书，跨文件比对不一致、漏项、格式错。提交前跑一遍。
tagline_en: Cross-document QC for spec, drawings, ADS, declaration, assignment, POA. Catches inconsistencies, missing parts.
desc_en: Comprehensive quality control for U.S. patent application filing documents. Use when the user asks to QC, check, validate, or review patent filing documents before submission to the USPTO. Performs 70+ automated and manual checks across specification, drawings, ADS, declaration, assignment, and power of attorney documents. Detects cross-document inconsistencies, formatting issues, missing required
why_zh: 不是单文件拼写检查，是跨文件一致性核验：同一术语在说明书和附图里写法不同。
why_en: Not a spellchecker—it cross-validates every filing document against each other, flagging mismatched terms, signature mismatches.
limit_zh: 只认美国临时/正式申请，不覆盖 PCT 或国外申请；只做提交前 QC，不写权利要求、不评可专利性。
limit_en: US non-provisional/provisional only; no PCT or foreign. Pre-filing QC only—no claim drafting or patentability opinion. Needs complete filing set.
title_en: 70+ checks across specs, drawings, ADS, declarations.
